app.name: X (formerly Twitter)
app.managed_alternative_note: Composio provides managed X connectors for AI agents to publish posts, read mentions, and interact with threads without individual developers having to purchase separate $100+/mo developer tier subscriptions.
when_to_byoc: Custom client attribution: Tweets must show 'via YourAppName' badge on X
Dedicated rate limits: High-frequency agent activity requiring isolated request ceilings
Direct enterprise billing: Organization requires direct billing and SLA relationship with X Corp

summary: Paywalled & strictly gated: Free tier is virtually unusable for multi-user agents; $100/mo Basic tier required for practical read/write API access.
difficulty_factors: +25 pts: Developer API access paywalled ($100/mo Basic tier minimum for multi-user read/write [as of Nov 2026, source: developer.x.com/en/portal/products])
+20 pts: Mandatory developer account enrollment with verified phone and credit card on file
+20 pts: Project and app gatekeeping in developer portal with strict policy compliance
+20 pts: OAuth 2.0 PKCE enforcement with granular user-context scopes and severe rate limits

time_estimate.dev_wait_claim: Instant upon paid subscription ($100/mo Basic tier)
time_estimate.production_wait_claim: Instant for Basic tier; manual review only for Pro ($5,000/mo) or Enterprise
time_estimate.approval_wait: Instant upon paid subscription; manual review for Pro/Enterprise

prerequisites: Verified X account with confirmed email and phone number
Credit card on file for developer subscription ($100/mo Basic tier)
Project & App created within developer.x.com portal

path.action: Enroll in X Developer Portal & Subscribe to Tier
path.detail: Go to developer.x.com -> Sign in -> Select 'Basic' tier ($100/month) or 'Free' tier (extremely limited: write-only, 1 app, 50 posts/month total). Enter billing details.

path.action: Create a Project and Attached App
path.detail: Inside the Developer Portal dashboard, create a new Project (describe use case) and attach a new Application.
Under App Settings -> 'User authentication settings' -> Click 'Set up'. Select 'OAuth 2.0', App type: 'Web App' or 'Native App'. Set Redirect URL and Website URL.
Choose 'Read and write and Direct message' or 'Read and write'. Copy Client ID and Client Secret (X requires PKCE for OAuth 2.0).
Generate code_verifier (high-entropy cryptographic random string) and code_challenge (SHA256 hashed). Pass code_challenge to /oauth2/authorize and code_verifier to /oauth2/token.

config_values.redirect_uri_format: https://yourdomain.com/oauth/callback/twitter (Must match exact URL in X Portal)

scopes.unlocks: Post tweets, reply to tweets, and delete tweets on user's behalf
View profile information of authenticated user
Receive refresh tokens for long-lived offline agent access

approval.what_reviewed: No manual human review for Basic or Pro tiers, but access is gated by paid credit-card subscription and automated policy violation algorithms.
typical_rejection_reasons: Credit card declined during developer portal enrollment
Automated spam filters flag newly created apps posting repetitive test tweets
what_to_prepare: Corporate credit card for recurring monthly developer fee
Valid HTTPS redirect URI and terms/privacy links

blockers_and_fixes.symptom: 403 Forbidden - When calling tweet search or reading user timelines
blockers_and_fixes.cause: Free tier does NOT include search endpoints or read capabilities for external accounts. Basic tier ($100/mo) is required.
blockers_and_fixes.fix: Upgrade to Basic tier in developer.x.com portal or route read queries through Composio managed connectors.
blockers_and_fixes.escalation_template: N/A - Hard payment gate enforced by X billing system.

blockers_and_fixes.symptom: invalid_request - code_verifier does not match code_challenge
blockers_and_fixes.cause: PKCE transformation error. X strictly requires S256 method with unpadded base64url encoding.
blockers_and_fixes.fix: Ensure code_challenge is base64url-encoded without '=' padding: crypto.createHash('sha256').update(verifier).digest('base64url').

agent_can_do: Implement RFC 7636 PKCE code challenge generation and validation
Draft OAuth 2.0 authorization URL with offline.access refresh flow
Handle X API v2 JSON payloads and rate-limit headers (x-rate-limit-remaining)
you_must_do: Enroll credit card and subscribe to the paid developer tier ($100/mo)
Pass SMS/phone number verification on your personal/company X account
Accept X Developer Agreement and Policy restrictions
agent_vs_human.handoff_critical_point: HUMAN MANDATORY: Payment of $100/mo and phone verification can only be executed by human developer.

what_to_do_next: Decide if the $100/mo X Developer Basic subscription is within budget or if Composio managed auth is preferable.
Log into developer.x.com with verified phone number and subscribe.
Set up OAuth 2.0 with PKCE using the agent's pre-configured route handler.

evidence.claim: X API requires paid subscription tier ($100/mo Basic) for realistic read/write agent operations
evidence.snippet: Free tier provides 1,500 post requests per month only. Basic tier at $100/month provides 10,000 read and 50,000 post requests per month.

evidence.claim: X OAuth 2.0 strictly requires PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange)
evidence.snippet: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE is required for authenticating users. Confidential and public clients must provide code_challenge.

evidence.claim: Offline access refresh tokens require explicit 'offline.access' scope
evidence.snippet: To obtain a refresh token for long-term user context access without re-prompting, include offline.access in your scope parameter.

uncertainties: X frequently alters API pricing tiers and rate limit quotas without extended deprecation notices (pricing verified active as of November 2026).

facts.quote: X Developer Portal provides OAuth 2.0 client credentials.
X API v2 endpoints require Basic (/mo) or Pro (,000/mo) tier.
